title: ConvoHop SDK public surface
description: The public API of one language's documented packages, as the language's extractor prints it. docgen extract adds $schema and stores it as docs/languages/<id>/surface.json. Extractors map their language's declarations onto these kinds. See docs/docs-pipeline.md.

packages.description: The packages of language.json, in its order.

symbols.description: Every public top-level declaration, sorted by name in code-unit order.

signatures.description: Declarations in the language's syntax, one per overload, without documentation comments.

docs.description: The documentation comment as Markdown, possibly empty. Renderers escape <, { and } outside code and turn headings into bold paragraphs, so headings such as ## Examples can repeat across symbols.

deprecated.description: Present when deprecated: the reason or replacement as Markdown, possibly empty. Renderers treat it like docs.

kind.description: interface includes protocols and traits; type includes aliases and named non-struct types; constant includes exported values.

origin.description: The package that declares the symbol, when another package re-exports it.

members.description: Public members: own members in declaration order, then inherited ones, nearest base first.

inherited.description: The base type that declares an inherited member.

members.description: Members of a property whose type is an object literal, such as a group of related methods.
